title: Three Weeks. You Are Not The Same | A Discipline Short Film
lines: Three weeks ago, he almost didn't start.
Today, he looks in the mirror and sees someone who shows up.
That's not a small change. That's a new identity.
You don't rise to your goals. You become the person who reaches them.
Every day was a vote for who he's becoming.
The old him wouldn't recognize this version.
This is only the beginning. Keep voting.
